risks: Two thumb jump tables (add pc,rN): _0225DDDE (4-case main state in ov32_0225DDC4) and _0225DE8E (9-case in ov32_0225DE34). MWCC switch lowering is a known matching hazard.

ov32_0225DE34 nested comparison ladder (mvn r1,#2 signed compares mixing bhi/bhs) around jump table - switch on GridInputHandler_HandleInput_AllowHold return with negative sentinels; signed/unsigned C shape delicate.

Large rodata strict ordering: _0225E15C,E168,E178,E188,E1A4,E1C0,E1DC,E204,E24C. Three BgTemplates used out-of-address-order (E1A4 layer4, E1C0 layer5, E188 layer6) - declaration order must still yield E188<E1A4<E1C0.
ov32_0225E0A8 reads 5th arg via 'ldr r1,=0xFFFFFFF8; add r1,sp; ldrb [r1,#0x10]' stack-arg trick - prototype needs right param count/width.
Heavy mov/lsl offset synthesis (0x144..0x2b0) - C must use plain member/array access; matching depends on field ordering.
sub_0202C6F4 / sub_0202C254 unresolved to a header - likely Save/PlayerProfile accessors; verify state[0x14] type.
GridInputHandler_*, 2D gfx res obj, G2dRenderer, Sprite headers inferred - confirm exact include/ names before extern decls; wrong signatures cascade via -ipa.
notes: Overlay 32 is a sub-screen touch/dpad UI listing player names across pages (8 names/page, up to 4 pages) with animated cursor and L/R page flip - likely a 'select which save/player to connect to' or download-play selection menu (sibling of OVY_28..33 in ov01_02206C60 overlay-manager table). Only 3 exports (ov32_0225D520 init, ov32_0225D5CC exit, ov32_0225D608 always-done probe) are locally defined; all other .public symbols are imports. Real per-frame logic runs in SysTask callback ov32_0225DDC4. ~35 functions, mechanically regular except two jump tables and anim/palette FSM (E048/E0A8/E0FC/DFE8).
